message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and I found myself channeling my inner MacGyver. My kids were initially in a panic, but as I pulled out our flashlights and power banks, their fears turned into a mini adventure. We ended up playing shadow puppets on the wall and telling stories by flashlight. It reminded me that a little preparedness can turn a hiccup into a memorable moment. Have you ever had a blackout that turned into an unexpected fun night?
